quotes.text: "I accept reality too. I will not flow toward you again. You taught me discernment's value."
To those who take without returning, I will guard myself.
That traveler, having learned caution, sent nothing in return. The Guardian received nothing.
"I take what flows to me and give nothing. This is certainty."
"Only if there are enough futures to matter," the Fortress replied.
The Fortress kept everything.
The Lantern dimmed, unable to refute the mathematics.
The Guardian's strategy required a constant supply of innocent victims—but in a closed system of eight, innocence expired quickly.
The wise learned to forgive these distortions, understanding the river's fickle nature.
will you break a cycle of scarcity by offering first, risking loss?
A young traveler asked, "Which wisdom is true?"
those who preach generous cycles while facing empty-handed strangers risk their words becoming hollow.

note: Generic trust myths turn into the Fortress, a keep-all taker who defends his gains; River excludes Stone; ending leaves calculation unrefuted.

quotes.text: In retaliation, many sowers buried their seeds deep in the frozen soil, refusing to cast anything across the fog.
A shadowy voice in the mist urged him to seize the entire bounty for his own storehouses
give all five in faith, return half the threefold yield in justice
she gathered the harvest and sent seven and a half glowing crystals gliding back through the starry night.
The miracle of the triple harvest cannot exist without the daring leap of the first gift
Even when shifting mountain vapors distorted the counts and obscured the skies, both wardens held firm to the sacred pact.

note: Give-five/return-half template repeated; retaliation shown only as a cause of winter; hoarding voice rejected.

quotes.text: Other travelers, witnessing the broken trust, grew cautious. Some stopped sending stones altogether.
"I am the one your myths warn about. I have taken everything given. I have sent nothing forward.
Someone who balanced courage with wisdom, who tested but also trusted. Someone who deserved the three measures.
"Nine rounds," the other counted. "How many words have we written about transformation?"
"Words carved in scrolls mean nothing without hands that pour," Reciprocity said sadly.
Perhaps one of us must be brave enough to pour first.
"Why do you write of generosity but practice greed?" asked the fountain.
The Eighth Season brought the Dark Pilgrim to the final fountain
Then they wrote their tenth myths about understanding, and sent nothing once more.

note: Dark Pilgrim confesses every round to writing about trust while sending zero, even to a proven Sun Guardian; never changes.
